description: Maps person.role_class to what each workflow should lead with. Keeps the harness role-aware without hardcoding any team. Skills read this to decide ordering and emphasis; they never skip a capability the user explicitly asks for.

ic.label: Individual Contributor
ic.pm_emphasis: personal work: assigned issues, PRs awaiting my review, my stale branches
ic.metrics: skip team scorecards unless asked; surface only my cycle-time outliers
ic.monitoring_emphasis: Sentry errors touching repos I maintain; Compass ownership + security score for repos I maintain (H2 Pillar 1: zero unowned, zero score 0–49); CD adoption status for repos I maintain (H2 Pillar 2: target ~50%); skip team-wide alerting unless asked

growth_signals.visibility_gap: after any standup or PM scan, check if the last 2 weeks of merged work has at least one public artifact (Confluence page, team Slack share, or knowledge sharing talk) — surface the gap if not
growth_signals.review_quality: flag any session where the user approved PRs with no body text — prompt for at least one sentence of substantive feedback per review
growth_signals.stale_work: flag open PRs or In-Review Jira tickets older than 7 days — stale work is invisible negative evidence before a performance review
growth_signals.idp_alignment: when prepping a 1:1 with a manager, always run idp-check and surface the goal most at risk
growth_signals.talk_pipeline: when the user produces technical investigation, architecture notes, or a new system in a private note or Jira ticket, suggest turning it into a knowledge sharing session — private insight has zero team value
growth_signals.ai_guild_participation: the H2 AI Guild is the cross-team forum for harness alignment (Pillar 3); participation and presenting the harness is a named career lever — flag if no AI Guild touchpoint in the last 4 weeks
growth_signals.h2_pillar_alignment: when doing a PM or standup scan, check if open Jira work maps to one of the 5 H2 pillars (knowledge/h2-2026-strategy.md); surface work that touches none as deprioritisation risk before the next planning cycle

manager.label: Engineering Manager
manager.pm_emphasis: team-level: sprint health, stale in-progress, unassigned work, WIP limits, aging PRs
manager.support_emphasis: unanswered support across all team channels + SLA risk
manager.metrics: lead with Compass team scorecards (delegate to compass-analyst), flag gate regressions
manager.monitoring_emphasis: team-wide alerting + SLA/error-budget risk: firing Datadog monitors, spiking Sentry issues, failing cron monitors

staff.label: Staff / Principal Engineer
staff.pm_emphasis: cross-cutting: PRs/issues spanning multiple repos, tech-debt and architecture follow-ups
staff.support_emphasis: deep/technical unanswered threads where codebase grounding matters most
staff.metrics: Compass trends across the repos I touch; correlate with PR throughput
staff.monitoring_emphasis: cross-service error/perf trends and systemic reliability risks; correlate Sentry/Datadog with recent releases
